context:
Goal: coordinators of child repos can get the acts the cloud refuses done.
Problem (rule): the standing grant "Acts the cloud refuses" in .claude/CLAUDE.md names only the claude-settings coordinator, so a child repo's coordinator must ask you for each act.
Based on (read): .claude/CLAUDE.md, Standing grants: a local session may set branch protection to the shared form, delete merged branches, and close PRs the coordinator names as replaced or empty (owner, 2026-10-30 16:20 CDT).
Based on (read): raised by lane one-lane-one-step (PR #1136).
Departs from: that grant, which names the claude-settings coordinator only — any repo's coordinator may ask, for the same three acts.

options.gain: Child repos clean up merged branches and replaced PRs without asking you each time.
options.how: The grant names each repo's coordinator; the three acts stay the same.
options.label: Widen to each repo's coordinator
options.lose: More sessions can ask a session on your computer for these acts.

options.label: Keep it
options.lose: Each child-repo cleanup waits on your word.

title: Should any repo's coordinator be able to ask a session on your computer for the three acts the cloud refuses?
why: The three acts are narrow and undoable or low-harm, and the same rule applies in every repo.
